request.item_at_issue: Brand-name CGRP inhibitor for chronic migraine prophylaxis
request.requested_disposition: Coverage approval for the requested medication

denial_rationale: Insurer stated member had not completed a documented trial of two preferred formulary alternatives before requesting the non-preferred medication.

known_facts.text: Member was prescribed a preferred formulary migraine preventive for 8 weeks with inadequate response, per prescriber note.
Member experienced a documented adverse reaction to a second preferred formulary alternative.

treatment_or_claim_history.description: Trial of preferred alternative #2 initiated, discontinued after adverse reaction.

available_evidence.description: Prescriber clinical note documenting both trials and outcomes

unknowns: Exact plan formulary tier language for the requested medication
Whether a formulary exception process was already attempted
